analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is a segmentation fault caused by accessing a null pointer when attempting to read data from the 'Data' array in the 'GetData' function. This occurs because the function does not properly validate the indices provided (nSet and nField) against the dimensions of the allocated data array, leading to out-of-bounds access.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The crash is triggered when 'GetData' is called with invalid indices (nSet or nField) that exceed the allocated bounds of the 'Data' array. Specifically, if the number of patches (nPatches) or samples (nSamples) are not correctly set or if they are negative, this leads to a NULL pointer dereference.
